label: Closed-collection rootedness: positive arguments, rivals and provisional judgment
summary: Analyst warrant assessment; no source was read, and every literature name below is an unread lead from memory, not an attribution. Meaning (DEF closed-collection rootedness): collect actual concreta together with every actual concrete ground of any of them; the collection contains something to which no actual concretum gives being. It forbids only rootless closed collections: a pure endless descent and a pure cycle. It allows endless descent and cycles above a root, and imposes no asymmetry, transitivity or uniform path-length bound. Under explicit excluded middle, CCR is equivalent to finite concrete-root access for every actual concretum. Positive arguments. (A) Dependence transmission ('borrowed reality'): wholly supplied being needs a supplier that is not itself supplied. Its collection form quantifies over all suppliers (NoWhollyBorrowedCollection, over every modelled actual supplier of the selected direct relation). It yields CCR under the sufficient open bridge that actual concreta are supplied only by concreta (ActualSuppliersOfConcretaConcrete; closedRootedOfBorrowed, verified, zero axioms); without the bridge it does not (Control.abstractSupplier: an abstract item grounds every member of a concrete regress, the principle holds and CCR fails), because CCR closes only over actual concrete grounds and an actual root may have abstract or unmodelled grounds. (A) is offered as a necessary conceptual principle. Under direct grounding it supports CCR but not AGWF's surplus: one root that directly grounds every member of a descending chain (Control.limitGrounder, a direct root grounder despite the name) satisfies both. Control.mediateFoundation encodes an isolated root alongside a rootless regress and violates CCR. A genuine foundation through intermediaries is an unresolved interpretation requiring additional structure; absence of direct root edges alone establishes neither mediated support nor failure of CCR. (B) Per se attenuation (closedRootedOfAttenuation): valid, and it can fail: its load-bearing clauses are uniform loss and a common bound, and the network analogues show the weighted-network theorem fails without each (binaryFixed, halfFixed; no Profile-level control). The per se clause, own esse only at roots (intermediates contribute nothing of their own), is the traditional one; for the uniform-loss clause no independent justification is on file (the recollection that traditional instrument examples are not described as lossy is unread and carries no evidential weight). So 'intermediates have no power of their own' alone does not yield CCR: lossless per se reception is satisfied by the pure regress, which violates CCR. (C) Graded argument: the limit grounder satisfies ascent along a grade with a maximum while the grade has infinite ascent; with #1515's equivalence this shows grades supply no independent warrant for no infinite ascent, and none for CCR was found. Rivals (objection standard). R1 grounding infinitism (leads: Bohn, Morganti, Bliss, Schaffer 2003, Tahko; unread). Target: CCR (formal shape Control.pureRegress). Mechanism: an actual rootless closed collection, each member grounded by another, the totality accounted for memberwise or holistically. Independent justification offered: the conceivability or physical possibility of no fundamental level, mostly compositional (gunk). Relevance: CCR as used here is an actual-world premise, so a merely possible rootless collection does not falsify it directly; but (A) is offered as a necessary conceptual principle, so a genuinely possible wholly borrowed collection of sustained concreta would defeat (A) as a necessary truth and with it the warrant (A) gives CCR. The rival bears on the selected relation (present esse support) if that relation is compositional dependence of wholes on parts or if a positive account of source-free real sustaining is given (#310: a coinductive or global fixed-point reading). Price: an actual collection whose being is supplied by nothing outside it, with no member having being otherwise. Status: the strongest standing rival; not refuted; no established counterexample. R2 coherentism or symmetric dependence (leads: Thompson 2016, Barnes 2018, Swanson; unread). Against CCR only for pure cycles; rooted cycles satisfy CCR (Control.rootedCycle), so against the join the rival must claim a pure cycle of sustaining with nothing outside it. (A recollection that its examples concern identity or nature dependence rather than sustaining of concrete existence is unread and carries no evidential weight.) It remains a substantive objection to asymmetry and to J2 (both still needed off the join's coverage routes). R3 infinite descending chains with a root that directly grounds every member: not a rival to CCR, a model of it; a rival only to AGWF and to no infinite ascent, and the coverage routes now accommodate it. Control.mediateFoundation supplies only an isolated root alongside a rootless regress. Genuine foundation through intermediaries remains unresolved and needs its own structure and bridge. R4 unbounded ascent: as recorded for the graded batch, it targets only the global no-infinite-ascent premise. Overall provisional judgment (revisable; not establishment): on the coverage routes of the join (underivedOfCoverageClosed and the two from-necessity routes), the regress commitment is strictly lowered from AGWF to CCR; the checks route still takes J2. Support for the join's regress step on those routes is modestly higher than under AGWF, for direct-foundation views: a root that directly grounds a descending chain, or a cycle, is compatible with it. Pure infinitism and pure coherentism remain rivals, each with an actual closed collection of sustained concreta that no actual concretum outside it supplies. Positive warrant for CCR rests mainly on (A) together with the concrete-supplier bridge; (B) adds little until uniform loss is independently motivated. Neither rival is refuted. Follow-up #1553 at shared baseline f9df3e2f7caf5fca6b31a465cbff5e655fedc394: warrant audit in docs/notes/direct-grounding-warrant.md, independently challenged after merge and repaired (2026-11-28). Inspection finds supply-closure is concrete-only, so abstract co-suppliers can vacate its test; under the concrete-supplier bridge borrowed reality and CCR are equivalent (later certified constructively, de375db2). The mediateFoundation code has an isolated root, with no actual mediated connection encoded. Retain its certified isolated-root-plus-regress claim; do not treat its interpretation as a certified transfinite foundation. Beginningless contingent foundation targets contingent grounding separately from CCR. No new proof or source attribution. Mixed-supplier follow-up: direct-grounding-warrant.md persists three explicit finite profiles and a reproducible exhaustive enumeration of 4,164 profiles on 1–3 actual candidates. A concrete root with abstract co-grounds satisfies CCR and borrowed reality while violating supplier concreteness. The localized bridge requires finite concrete-root access only for abstract-supplied concrete recipients; finite tests pass and the general deduction was later certified (2170237a). General sibling certification (#1575): ConcreteRootAccess certifies finite actual concrete endpoint paths, CCR/access equivalence, constructive CCR-to-borrowed reality, the localized decomposition under explicit excluded middle, and a separate constructive blanket-bridge equivalence (eight results; exact bindings, Comparator with empty permitted axioms, NanoDa and CI). These are reformulations within one equivalence class, not independent support: borrowed reality is proved only from CCR (loop_back, connected only), so the borrowed routes to CCR are circular until borrowed reality or the localized bridge gains support not routed through CCR. Mixed realization rival, challenge repair 2026-11-28: the supply edge has two recorded senses (disambiguation acb74cb3, SUPPLY_EDGE_1 partial co-ground and SUPPLY_EDGE_2 sufficient supply). Under CONCRETE_6 an abstract supplier L either has esse in re, so it is concrete and, without a concrete supplier, an ActualRoot that makes CCR hold, or lacks esse in re and owes an account of supplying esse without it, which no record gives. Classified no substantive objection identified, as in esse-root-leaves.md (f) row 6; kept as the formal alternative MixedSupplierCensus.cycleRow; no rival defeat. On the partial sense L's edges stay in the selected relation, so borrowed reality holds vacuously on the mixed profile; reaching the pure concrete rootless network (R1/R2) would need a relation without L's edges, which no record justifies. Priority 5 audit (docs/notes/de-ente-esse-source-1628.md, Supplier completeness under extension): a single-root assignment and a rootless acyclic assignment on the same actual roster agree on every immediate supplier of any prescribed finite set of recipients. In an independently finite, supply-closed nonempty domain, strict priority calibrated in the integers instead yields a source by a finite minimum. Local Lean controls checked. Scope remains relative to the selected supply relation; real closure/finiteness and calibration at esse are open. No new formal route. The further finite audit test fixes one recipient and compares complete incoming supplier lists against all relations on the same bearer roster. A finite witness to a particular root needs one path. Ruling out every root needs a finite, supplier-complete, rootless cone. A registered application uses the per-bearer positive criterion to reach 20babef7 on the actual esse relation. See the linked section “What can a finite audit establish about this recipient’s first giver?” for the two-bearer control and a reproducible object trace. A follow-up on graded evidence counts the finite depths that predict the same complete supplier lists, then updates only on new lists. At the frozen Git head exactly four of 5,810 commits reach first-parent depth 1,500. On the stipulated causal interpretation the finite and endless models also differ on the Second Way’s no-regress premise. The visibility follow-up checks when incomplete observation preserves the evidential force of a positive trace and when an unmarked stop erases the distinction between an actual first giver and a hidden supplier. A shallow and a complete Git view of f03eb49c4 display the same object with different traversal boundaries. The pairwise follow-up in attempt ae9e1522 tested sender identification through kernel credentials and formalized the donor coverage needed to identify a particular first giver. The earlier complete-list assessment retains its reviewed scope. Lane E, #2103 (2026-11-27): disposition (iv) for the supplier-prefix likelihood hub. Its conditional likelihood contrasts do not identify a named source from a matched singleton prefix. The connection plan points to the existing finite actual-esse audit premise. Reopen on an audit with independently verified complete lists for actual esse supply, including the empty list at the terminal ancestor. Verification at one recipient would establish only a local certificate.
blocker: Independent warrant for CCR remains open. The live comparison is borrowed reality (45890c84) against a pure concrete rootless fixed-point network (R1/R2). It needs an independently motivated generation standard for concrete existence; choosing least-fixed-point semantics selects that standard rather than deriving it. The mixed abstract-realizer variant is classified no substantive objection identified under CONCRETE_6; reopen it on a positive account of esse supplied by something without esse in re, or on a defended reading of ExistsAt that admits such suppliers. See docs/notes/direct-grounding-warrant.md, General certification and realization test.

current_assessment.scope: When can finite observations of suppliers certify a particular supplierless ancestor or exclude every such ancestor of the same recipient? Complete incoming lists, fixed bearer identities, and all relation completions. On the linear alternatives, how does the likelihood of successive matching lists change? Which observations distinguish a verified first cause from loss of access to an earlier cause?
current_assessment.assessment: A finite record can identify a particular supplierless ancestor by preserving one path to the recipient and the ancestor’s empty incoming list. Excluding every such ancestor requires checking the whole finite rootless predecessor cone. In an acyclic cone that negative verdict always escapes finite audit. In the repository’s own recorded ancestry, the positive test identified a parentless ancestor by one hash-verified path. For the De ente argument, positive certificates for every actual bearer on the same existential relation suffice for rootedness. The key warrant at a candidate source is completeness of its list of existential suppliers. Classical rootedness also gives availability of those certificates, so appealing to that converse adds no independent warrant. With a proper distribution fixed in advance over finite root depths, matching lists beyond the depths the account expected can favor the endless chain. An empty supplier list at the end of that same trace rules it out. Repeating an observation adds no evidence. The actual finite Git genealogy verifies the sampling distinction. It supplies no empirical depth distribution for giving of existence. An unmarked stop fits both a genuine root and a hidden supplier. Equal positive visibility of a true prefix under both accounts preserves its likelihood ratio. Known visibility and a known finite tail below one also identify the endless mixture share at a single cutoff from an exact observed rate. A common hard cap can hide even opposite population shares. No sampling model for actual existential dependence has been calibrated here.
current_assessment.next_test: For the same proposed giver, identify an independent means of finding a supplier missed by the original search and establish which suppliers that check covers. For positive prefix evidence, test whether access to actual suppliers is equally likely under the competing accounts. To estimate a population share also justify the sampling population and calibrated coverage; identification from exact rates leaves sampling error open.
